title: Contractors taking Lahaina rebuilders' money
summary: The prosecuting attorney has asked for an investigator position dedicated full time to possible contractor fraud in Lahaina. The request follows a council member's statement that a contractor who presented at a council committee left with people's money without delivering the work.

timeline.text: A member said a contractor who presented at a council committee left with people's money without delivering.
The prosecuting attorney asked for an investigator position to work full time on possible contractor fraud in Lahaina.
